items.title: District-Level Children’s Science Congress held at Khliehriat
items.summary: The Meghalaya Government reported that the East Jaintia Hills district-level Children’s Science Congress was held at Khliehriat on 16 October. The release highlighted the theme “Science and Innovation for Sustainability” and encouraged students to explore science rather than memorise concepts.
items.exam: Science education, sustainability, East Jaintia Hills and state current affairs.

items.title: PM-SETU approves five ITI-cluster investment plans
items.summary: The Press Information Bureau reported that the National Steering Committee approved five Strategic Investment Plans worth ₹1,194.92 crore for ITI clusters in Maharashtra, Odisha and Jammu & Kashmir. This is approval of investment plans; it should not be confused with expenditure already completed.
items.exam: PM-SETU, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, vocational training and public-private partnerships.

items.title: Foreign-exchange reserves reported at US$726.03 billion
items.summary: The Economic Times reported, citing Reserve Bank of India data, that India’s foreign-exchange reserves stood at US$726.03 billion for the week ended 9 October 2026. The article reported a weekly fall; reserve figures change from week to week.
items.exam: RBI, balance of payments, foreign-exchange reserves and macroeconomic indicators.

items.title: Astronomers report a green-coloured white dwarf
items.summary: Reuters reported the identification of WD J1330+6435, a white dwarf about 280 light-years away in Draco. Researchers attributed its unusual green appearance to atmospheric chemistry involving sodium under the star’s extreme density; it is a stellar remnant, not a normal Sun-like star.
items.exam: White dwarfs, stellar evolution, spectroscopy and scientific reporting.

items.title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar added to India’s squad for the fifth T20I
items.summary: The BCCI announced on 16 October that Bhuvneshwar Kumar had been added to India’s squad for the fifth T20I against West Indies after Arshdeep Singh sustained a blow to his bowling shoulder. BCCI said a final participation decision would depend on recovery; this card does not presume the match result.
items.exam: Cricket current affairs, squad announcements and official sports releases.
